config.horse-flute.enabled.name: Enabled
config.horse-flute.enabled.tooltip: Stores the vanilla Horse Flute in the wallet and lets you use it with a hotkey.

config.horse-flute.auto-store.tooltip: Moves a vanilla Horse Flute into the wallet when it enters your inventory.
config.horse-flute.use.name: Use Horse Flute
config.horse-flute.use.tooltip: Uses the real vanilla Horse Flute from the wallet.
config.fashion-sense.enabled.name: Enabled
config.fashion-sense.enabled.tooltip: Stores the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror in the wallet and lets you use it with a hotkey.
config.fashion-sense.auto-store.name: Auto Store From Inventory
config.fashion-sense.auto-store.tooltip: Moves a Fashion Sense Hand Mirror into the wallet when it enters your inventory.
config.fashion-sense.use.name: Use Hand Mirror
config.fashion-sense.use.tooltip: Uses the real Fashion Sense Hand Mirror from the wallet.
config.animal-husbandry.enabled.name: Mod Enabled
config.animal-husbandry.enabled.tooltip: Enables Wallet Tools for Animal Husbandry.
config.animal-husbandry.auto-use.name: Enable Auto Use
config.animal-husbandry.auto-use.tooltip: Automatically supplies the stored Meat Cleaver or Meat Wand when using it on a nearby farm animal. Manual hotkey use still works when this is disabled.
Require Left Ctrl to be held while clicking an animal before the wallet Meat Cleaver or Meat Wand is supplied automatically.
config.animal-husbandry.swap-sound.name: Play Tool Swap Sound
config.animal-husbandry.swap-sound.toolt: Play the Wallet Tools swap sound when the meat tool is readied.
config.animal-husbandry.stored-message.t: Show a HUD message when the Meat Cleaver or Meat Wand is moved to the wallet.
Hotkey to toggle automatic Animal Husbandry wallet use on or off.
config.animal-husbandry.use-tool.name: Use Meat Tool
config.animal-husbandry.use-tool.tooltip: Immediately use the wallet Meat Cleaver or Meat Wand.
hud.animal-husbandry-auto-use-enabled: Animal Husbandry wallet auto use enabled.
hud.animal-husbandry-auto-use-disabled: Animal Husbandry wallet auto use disabled.
hud.animal-husbandry-tool-stored: Animal Husbandry tool moved to wallet.
hud.animal-husbandry-tool-returned: Animal Husbandry tool returned to inventory.
config.nature.enabled.name: Mod Enabled
config.nature.enabled.tooltip: Enables Wallet Tools for Nature in the Valley.
config.nature.auto-use.name: Enable Auto Use
config.nature.auto-use.tooltip: Automatically supplies the stored Nature in the Valley net when using it on a nearby Nature in the Valley creature. Manual hotkey use still works when this is disabled.
config.nature.require-shift.name: Require Left Shift + Click
config.nature.require-shift.tooltip: Require Left Shift to be held while clicking near a Nature in the Valley creature before the wallet Nature in the Valley net is supplied automatically.
config.nature.swap-sound.name: Play Tool Swap Sound
config.nature.swap-sound.tooltip: Play the Wallet Tools swap sound when the nature net is readied.
config.nature.stored-message.name: Show Stored Message
config.nature.stored-message.tooltip: Show a HUD message when the Nature in the Valley net is moved to the wallet.
config.nature.toggle-auto-use.name: Toggle Auto Use
config.nature.toggle-auto-use.tooltip: Hotkey to toggle automatic Nature in the Valley wallet use on or off.
config.nature.use-net.name: Use Nature Net
config.nature.use-net.tooltip: Immediately use the wallet Nature in the Valley net.
hud.nature-auto-use-enabled: Nature in the Valley wallet auto use enabled.
hud.nature-auto-use-disabled: Nature in the Valley wallet auto use disabled.
hud.nature-net-stored: Nature in the Valley net moved to wallet.
hud.nature-net-returned: Nature in the Valley net returned to inventory.
config.coin-collector.enabled.name: Mod Enabled
config.coin-collector.enabled.tooltip: Enables Wallet Tools for Coin Collector Redux.
config.coin-collector.passive.name: Enable Passive Wallet Detection
config.coin-collector.passive.tooltip: Lets Coin Collector Redux's passive polling use the Metal Detector stored in the wallet. This does not affect Coin Collector Redux's swing-only mode.
config.coin-collector.manual.name: Enable Manual Use Hotkey
config.coin-collector.manual.tooltip: Allows the configured hotkey to ping the wallet Metal Detector.
config.coin-collector.swap-sound.name: Play Tool Swap Sound
config.coin-collector.swap-sound.tooltip: Play the Wallet Tools swap sound when the wallet Metal Detector is used manually.
config.coin-collector.stored-message.too: Show a HUD message when the Metal Detector is moved to the wallet.
config.coin-collector.use-detector.name: Use Metal Detector
config.coin-collector.use-detector.toolt: Ping the Metal Detector stored in the wallet.
item.metal-detector.name: Metal Detector
config.tractor.enabled.name: Enable Tractor Wallet Selector
config.tractor.enabled.tooltip: Allows Tractor Mod to use supported tools stored by Wallet Tools while riding the tractor.
config.tractor.previous.name: Cycle Previous Tool
config.tractor.previous.tooltip: Cycles the tractor wallet selector to the previous stored tool.
config.tractor.next.name: Cycle Next Tool
config.tractor.next.tooltip: Cycles the tractor wallet selector to the next stored tool.
config.tractor.overlay.name: Show Selector Overlay
config.tractor.overlay.tooltip: Shows the selected tractor wallet tool while riding the tractor.
config.tractor.position.name: Selector Overlay Position
config.tractor.position.tooltip: Moves the selector overlay to the top-center of the screen, left of the inventory bar, or right of the inventory bar.
config.tractor.cycle-sound.name: Play Cycle Sound
config.tractor.cycle-sound.tooltip: Plays a sound when cycling the tractor wallet selector.
config.tractor.debug.name: Debug Logging
config.tractor.debug.tooltip: Writes extra diagnostic messages to the SMAPI console.

config.auto-petter.enabled.name: Enabled

config.auto-petter.auto-store.tooltip: Automatically move the first Auto-Petter you obtain into the wallet.
config.auto-petter.icon.name: Show wallet icon
config.auto-petter.icon.tooltip: Draw the stored Auto-Petter in the inventory wallet area.
config.auto-petter.message.name: Show stored message
config.auto-petter.message.tooltip: Show a HUD message when an Auto-Petter is moved to the wallet.
config.auto-petter.friendship.name: Apply friendship gain
config.auto-petter.friendship.tooltip: Apply a small daily friendship increase when the wallet Auto-Petter pets animals.
config.auto-petter.points.name: Friendship points per day

power.scepter.description: The golden handle quivers with raw potential. Press the Wallet Scepter hotkey to return home at will.
config.scepter.use.name: Use Wallet Scepter
config.scepter.use.tooltip: Activates the wallet Return Scepter through the real in-game Return Scepter use path. Default: Left Control + S.
config.scepter.auto-return.name: Auto Return Home at 01:00
config.scepter.auto-return.tooltip: After your Return Scepter is wallet-unlocked, offers or performs a late-night farm return at 01:00.
config.scepter.ask.name: Ask Before Auto Return
config.scepter.ask.tooltip: When enabled, 01:00 shows choices to return home, stay out, or go to bed. When disabled, 01:00 immediately returns you to the farm.
config.scepter.require.name: Require Wallet Unlock
config.scepter.require.tooltip: When enabled, the hotkey only works after this mod has converted a real Return Scepter into a wallet-style unlock.
config.scepter.missing-message.name: Show Missing Scepter Message
config.scepter.missing-message.tooltip: Shows a HUD message when the hotkey is pressed before the Return Scepter has been unlocked.
hud.scepter-missing: You do not have the Return Scepter in your wallet.
hud.scepter-returned-home: Return Scepter brought you home for the night.
dialogue.scepter.question: You feel the subtle pull of the Scepter. Let it bring you home?
item.return-scepter.name: Return Scepter

config.sword-and-sorcery.prefer.name: Prefer Same-Tier Sword and Sorcery Tools
config.sword-and-sorcery.prefer.tooltip: When a Sword and Sorcery tool has the same upgrade tier as the stored wallet tool, prefer the Sword and Sorcery version.
config.sword-and-sorcery.debug.name: Debug Logging
config.sword-and-sorcery.debug.tooltip: Enables extra compatibility diagnostics in the SMAPI console.

config.timeless-pocket-watch.enabled.too: Stores the Timeless Pocket Watch in the wallet, activates it through a configurable hotkey, and lets Shift + right-click load its clockwork gears when the Timeless Pocket Watch mod is installed.
Moves the watch with the highest attached gear tier and charge count into the wallet while preserving the exact tool, attachment stack, and mod data. Lower-tier watches remain in the inventory.
config.timeless-pocket-watch.power.name: Show Wallet Power
config.timeless-pocket-watch.power.toolt: Shows the stored Timeless Pocket Watch in the wallet powers list with its current attached gear tier and charge count.
Plays the Wallet Tools swap sound when the stored Timeless Pocket Watch is activated or deactivated.
config.timeless-pocket-watch.stored-mess: Shows a HUD message when a Timeless Pocket Watch is moved into the wallet.
config.timeless-pocket-watch.gear-messag: Shows a HUD message when Shift + right-click loads, merges, or replaces clockwork gears in the stored Timeless Pocket Watch.
config.timeless-pocket-watch.missing-mes: Shows a HUD message when the watch hotkey or gear-loading gesture is used before a Timeless Pocket Watch is stored in the wallet.
config.timeless-pocket-watch.use.name: Use Timeless Pocket Watch
config.timeless-pocket-watch.use.tooltip: Activates or deactivates the stored Timeless Pocket Watch through the watch mod’s real tool-use path. Default: Left Control + T.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-stored: Timeless Pocket Watch moved to wallet.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-returned: Timeless Pocket Watch returned to inventory.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-missing: You do not have a Timeless Pocket Watch in your wallet.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-empty: The Timeless Pocket Watch has no clockwork gears attached.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-gear-missing-w: Store a Timeless Pocket Watch in the wallet before loading clockwork gears.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-gear-state-unk: Wallet Tools could not verify the Timeless Pocket Watch state, so its gears were not changed.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-gear-deactivat: The Timeless Pocket Watch could not be safely deactivated, so its gears were not changed.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-gear-attachmen: The stored Timeless Pocket Watch cannot accept clockwork gears.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-gear-full: {{gearName}} is already at the watch's maximum charge stack ({{count}}).
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-gear-added: Added {{added}} {{gearName}} to the Timeless Pocket Watch. Total charges: {{count}}.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-gear-loaded: Loaded {{gearName}} ×{{count}} into the Timeless Pocket Watch.
hud.timeless-pocket-watch-gear-replaced: Replaced {{oldGearName}} ×{{oldCount}} with {{newGearName}} ×{{newCount}}. The old gears were returned to the clicked inventory slot.
power.timeless-pocket-watch.attach-hint: Shift + right-click a clockwork gear in your inventory to load or replace it.
item.timeless-pocket-watch.name: Timeless Pocket Watch
item.timeless-pocket-watch.description: An odd pocket watch that hums with power.
